question: Goa annually celebrates its Statehood Days on_________________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thu May 30 2024 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Goa celebrates its Statehood Day annually on May 30**.
 
• On May 30, 1987, Goa was **officially declared as the 25th state of India**.
 
• Prior to statehood, Goa was a Union Territory along with Daman and Diu.
 
• Goa is known for its **rich cultural heritage, beautiful beaches, and vibrant tourism industry**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Statehood Day**

 
 
• Statehood Day is the anniversary of the day a state was established or recognized as a state.
 
• It is often celebrated with various cultural events, parades, and official ceremonies.
 
• Statehood Day is an important occasion for citizens to reflect on their state's history and achievements.
 
 
 
• **Goa's History**
 
 
• Goa was a Portuguese colony for about 450 years until it was liberated by the Indian Armed Forces in 1961.
 
• After liberation, Goa was integrated into India as a Union Territory.
 
• Goa's statehood was conferred after a prolonged movement and political struggle by its residents.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Statehood**
 
 
• Statehood provides a state with greater autonomy and representation in the Indian Union.
 
• It allows the state to have its own government and legislative assembly, which can make laws on subjects within the state list.
 
• Statehood also brings economic and administrative benefits, enabling the state to better manage its resources and development programs.
